chapter.heading: Psalm 61
Lead Me to the Rock
To the choirmaster: with stringed instruments. Of David.
chapter.v:
for you
have been,
my refuge, a strong tower against the enemy.

Let me
dwell in,
your tent forever! Let me take refuge under the shelter of your wings! Selah

For you,
O God,,
have heard my vows; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

Prolong the
life of,
the king; may his years endure to all generations!

May he
be enthroned,
forever before God; appoint steadfast love and faithfulness to watch over him!

So will
I ever,
sing praises to your name, as I perform my vows day after day. (ESV)
